# Data Source: stripe_radar_value_list_item

A value in a Radar value list. `terraform destroy` deletes the item.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_radar_value_list_item" "spammer" {
  id = stripe_radar_value_list_item.spammer.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

Exactly one must be set.

* `id` - (Optional) Unique identifier for the object.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `created_by` - The name or email address of the user who added this item to the value list.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `value` - The value of the item (whose type must match the type of the parent value list).
* `value_list` - The identifier of the value list which the created item will be added to.
